headline: Turkey's Togg Vehicle Deliveries Projected Near 60,000 Units in 2026
summary: Turkish electric vehicle maker Togg is expected to deliver nearly 60,000 vehicles in 2026, up from approximately 39,000 in 2025, according to the Industry and Technology Minister.
why: Production volume and delivery targets provide key benchmarks for evaluating the scale and growth trajectory of domestic automotive manufacturers.

impacts.name: Automotive
impacts.why: Increased vehicle deliveries indicate expanding domestic production capacity.
